description: Execute Google Antigravity CLI (agy) in print mode with model selection, conversation resume, and workspace controls.

continueLatest.description: Use --continue to resume the most recent conversation.

conversationId.description: Native Antigravity conversation ID to resume (--conversation). Overrides sessionId lookup.

dryRun.description: Return the resolved CLI argv as JSON without spawning agy.

effort.description: Reasoning effort (--effort). Supported levels depend on the model — see list-models. Use with a base model ID (e.g. gemini-4-hydrogen); not supported by Orchestrator.

mode.description: Agent mode (--mode): accept-edits, auto (sandboxed autonomy; not available on every account), or plan (answers go into a plan artifact).

model.description: Optional model override (ID or display label from `agy models`). Known: Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Low), Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Medium), Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High), Gemini 4 Hydrogen (XHigh), Gemini 4 Argon (Low), Gemini 4 Argon (Medium), Gemini 4 Argon (High), Gemini 4 Carbon (Low), Gemini 4 Carbon (Medium), Gemini 4 Carbon (High), Orchestrator (Argon), Orchestrator (Carbon), Gemini 3.8 Flash (Low), Gemini 3.8 Flash (Medium), Gemini 3.8 Flash (High), Claude Opus 5.5 (Low), Claude Opus 5.5 (Medium), Claude Opus 5.5 (High), Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Low), Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Medium), Claude Sonnet 5.5 (High), GPT-OSS 120B (Medium). If omitted, uses your Antigravity CLI default.

prompt.description: Task or question. Reference files by path — agy reads them with its own tools.

resetSession.description: Clear session context before execution. Starts fresh conversation.

responseMode.description: Response verbosity: "clean" returns only the final answer (default), "full" includes the stderr execution log.

sessionId.description: Internal session ID for conversation continuity (workspace-isolated).

workingDir.description: Working directory for execution (alias of cd)

name: ask-antigravity
